decisions.reason: Real security event: Citrix confirms active exploitation of NetScaler zero-day RCE flaws CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772 (CVSS 9.5); belongs to existing NetScaler zero-day story.

CVE-2026-88771.evidence: Event reports Citrix confirmed active exploitation; CISA urges assessment for compromise; unauthenticated remote attacker can execute arbitrary commands on all NetScaler ADC/Gateway deployments.

CVE-2026-88772.evidence: Event reports confirmed active exploitation; memory-overflow leading to RCE or DoS when DTLS enabled (default on VPN virtual servers).
